root_cause: Fork idiom patterns from f1b7aebff8c2 (retyped in 93e0fc427e93) selected P_CLIPR for smin(smax(x,~b),b)/smax(smin(x,b),~b) with any register b, and P_CLIPUR for the unsigned betweenu shape. ISA (GVSoC pulp_v2.hpp:1949 p_clip_exec low=-b-1 high=b + int.h:1291 lib_CLIP; :1958 p_clipu_exec + int.h:1305 lib_CLIPU signed) equals the C clamp only when b>=0; for b<0 the C idioms return b (or ~b) for all x, p.clipr returns ~b for x<~b. betweenu (umin(umax(x,0),b)=umin(x,b)) was dead (umax(x,0) folds) and not equivalent to p.clipur for negative x even with b>=0.
fix: New PatFrags clipr_idiom (same between(not b,b,x) shape) and clipur_idiom (F008's signed clipu_idiom shapes) with PredicateCodeUsesOperands and CurDAG->SignBitIsZero(Operands[0]); clipur_idiom also rejects ConstantSDNode bounds so constant clamps keep their current code (p.clipu imm via F008, else p.max/p.min). Unused wrong betweenu fragment removed. Builtin patterns (int_riscv_pulp_clip_r/clipu_r) unchanged. Upstream CORE-V (RISCVInstrInfoXCV.td:231-233,797-798 @llvmorg-20.1.8) selects cv.clipr/cv.clipur only from intrinsics; PredicateCodeUsesOperands usage follows RISCVInstrInfoZb.td:183-188. GAP9 GCC emits not+p.max+p.min for these idioms (logs/20-F012/gcc_probe.c).
behaviour_change: Unknown-sign register bound: p.clipr -> not+p.max+p.min (same as GAP9 GCC). Known non-negative register bound (b&0x7fff, (unsigned)b>>1, zext u16): p.clipr kept; clipu-shaped clamps now become p.clipur (was p.max+p.min; newly live, correct by ISA semantics). Constant bounds and builtins unchanged.
